2026-10-15 local compatibility change (2.1.6-career1):
Resolve CCSPlayerPawn::m_pBot from the running CS2 schema once during plugin
load instead of retaining the platform constant. No old-offset fallback.
If the field is unavailable, use the upstream inactive-plugin error path
before a native hook is installed. Log the resolved field for diagnosis.
Keep upstream aim priorities, weapon selection, visibility checks, hook,
CCSBot target/enemy/visibility offsets, and controller-cache behavior intact.
No BotAI or CareerMatch native function-body patches are added or removed.

Official Windows 1.4.6 ZIP SHA256:
e66a17329ccb00b340555fb64b09b0771ea4a0aa04566e7b9a915d7ad4c6f28e
Official BotAimImprover.dll SHA256:
d11a2e2d67f8fba62afb22ce958926b63ff34b74022e9c0d192d1c61e318b77a
Static PE/IL audit confirmed its .cctor IL_027e hard-codes 0x1518.
CS2 build 2000933's schema is 0x14F8; build 2000930's schema is 0x1518.
